original_preflight_split_issue: Original (M3/10 + M4/10)%4 == 0 formula selects no poses on the 45+10*n elbow grid; retained session.json records that flawed preflight wording.
actual_before_first_fit_policy: groups.json was written before first fitting; last whole pose of each pure-joint group held out from that group training fit. Other final all-pose fits are explicitly diagnostic reconstructions, not held-out predictions.
whole_pose_angle_reference: Separate settled exposure supplies orientation only where available; held-out camera translation and first-image corner pixels never enter training. Same-lens correlations explicitly retained.
whole_deployment_scope: A/B compared to later independently reconstructed centred D. D local leave-whole-pose tests are NOT frozen A/B model third-session command predictions.
bootstrap: 200 whole-pose model-free SE3 resamples per D shoulder sweep; reported failures, not 200 successful pixel-bundle refits.
unavailable_full_protocol: full global two-joint optical/marker bundle and adoption integration
